definitions.name: Get Gmail Message (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Get Gmail Message: GET /messages/{messageId}. One fixed-host HTTPS request, zero retries, redirect:error, no auto pagination. Optional userId defaults to me. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken selected with config.$connection; named GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret overrides credential token. Token issuance, refresh, OAuth consent, restricted-scope verification and scopes are external prerequisites. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8 JSON; opaque IDs exclude dot/percent/slash before credentials. 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; 100 ms bounded cleanup; 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 256 KiB raw/attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Raw MIME/base64url and threadId are transmitted unchanged; ordered repeated headers are retained. Known resource fields projected; absent remains absent, explicit null rejected where Gmail declares non-null. MIME nesting supports eight child levels and rejects deeper parts. No MIME construction/parsing, upload sessions, watch/push listeners or automatic sends. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1 https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.threads https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.labels https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.drafts https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.history/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages.attachments/get https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users/getProfile https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/sending https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/auth/scopes

definitions.name: Get Gmail Attachment (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Get Gmail Attachment: GET /messages/{messageId}/attachments/{attachmentId}. One fixed-host HTTPS request, zero retries, redirect:error, no auto pagination. Optional userId defaults to me. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken selected with config.$connection; named GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret overrides credential token. Token issuance, refresh, OAuth consent, restricted-scope verification and scopes are external prerequisites. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8 JSON; opaque IDs exclude dot/percent/slash before credentials. 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; 100 ms bounded cleanup; 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 256 KiB raw/attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Raw MIME/base64url and threadId are transmitted unchanged; ordered repeated headers are retained. definitions.name: Modify Gmail Message Labels (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Modify Gmail Message Labels: POST /messages/{messageId}/modify. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation MESSAGES_MODIFY. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-host HTTPS request, zero retries, redirect:error, no auto pagination. Optional userId defaults to me. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken selected with config.$connection; named GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret overrides credential token. Token issuance, refresh, OAuth consent, restricted-scope verification and scopes are external prerequisites. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8 JSON; opaque IDs exclude dot/percent/slash before credentials. 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; 100 ms bounded cleanup; 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 256 KiB raw/attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Raw MIME/base64url and threadId are transmitted unchanged; ordered repeated headers are retained. Known resource fields projected; absent remains absent, explicit null rejected where Gmail declares non-null. MIME nesting supports eight child levels and rejects deeper parts. No MIME construction/parsing, upload sessions, watch/push listeners or automatic sends. definitions.name: Trash Gmail Message (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Trash Gmail Message: POST /messages/{messageId}/trash. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation MESSAGES_TRASH. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-host HTTPS request, zero retries, redirect:error, no auto pagination. Optional userId defaults to me. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken selected with config.$connection; named GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret overrides credential token. Token issuance, refresh, OAuth consent, restricted-scope verification and scopes are external prerequisites. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8 JSON; opaque IDs exclude dot/percent/slash before credentials. 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; 100 ms bounded cleanup; 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 256 KiB raw/attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Raw MIME/base64url and threadId are transmitted unchanged; ordered repeated headers are retained. Known resource fields projected; absent remains absent, explicit null rejected where Gmail declares non-null. MIME nesting supports eight child levels and rejects deeper parts. No MIME construction/parsing, upload sessions, watch/push listeners or automatic sends. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1 https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.threads https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.labels https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.drafts https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.history/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages.attachments/get https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users/getProfile https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/sending https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/auth/scopes

definitions.name: Untrash Gmail Message (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Untrash Gmail Message: POST /messages/{messageId}/untrash. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation MESSAGES_UNTRASH. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-host HTTPS request, zero retries, redirect:error, no auto pagination. Optional userId defaults to me. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken selected with config.$connection; named GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret overrides credential token. Token issuance, refresh, OAuth consent, restricted-scope verification and scopes are external prerequisites. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8 JSON; opaque IDs exclude dot/percent/slash before credentials. 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; 100 ms bounded cleanup; 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 256 KiB raw/attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Raw MIME/base64url and threadId are transmitted unchanged; ordered repeated headers are retained. Known resource fields projected; absent remains absent, explicit null rejected where Gmail declares non-null. MIME nesting supports eight child levels and rejects deeper parts. No MIME construction/parsing, upload sessions, watch/push listeners or automatic sends. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1 https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.threads https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.labels https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.drafts https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.history/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages.attachments/get https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users/getProfile https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/sending https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/auth/scopes

definitions.name: Permanently Delete Gmail Message (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Permanently Delete Gmail Message: DELETE /messages/{messageId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation MESSAGES_DELETE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-host HTTPS request, zero retries, redirect:error, no auto pagination. Optional userId defaults to me. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken selected with config.$connection; named GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret overrides credential token. Token issuance, refresh, OAuth consent, restricted-scope verification and scopes are external prerequisites. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8 JSON; opaque IDs exclude dot/percent/slash before credentials. 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; 100 ms bounded cleanup; 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 256 KiB raw/attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Raw MIME/base64url and threadId are transmitted unchanged; ordered repeated headers are retained. Known resource fields projected; absent remains absent, explicit null rejected where Gmail declares non-null. MIME nesting supports eight child levels and rejects deeper parts. No MIME construction/parsing, upload sessions, watch/push listeners or automatic sends. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1 https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.threads https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.labels https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.drafts https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.history/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages.attachments/get https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users/getProfile https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/sending https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/auth/scopes

definitions.name: Modify Gmail Thread Labels (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Modify Gmail Thread Labels: POST /threads/{threadId}/modify. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation THREADS_MODIFY. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-host HTTPS request, zero retries, redirect:error, no auto pagination. Optional userId defaults to me. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken selected with config.$connection; named GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret overrides credential token. Token issuance, refresh, OAuth consent, restricted-scope verification and scopes are external prerequisites. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8 JSON; opaque IDs exclude dot/percent/slash before credentials. 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; 100 ms bounded cleanup; 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 256 KiB raw/attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Raw MIME/base64url and threadId are transmitted unchanged; ordered repeated headers are retained. Known resource fields projected; absent remains absent, explicit null rejected where Gmail declares non-null. MIME nesting supports eight child levels and rejects deeper parts. No MIME construction/parsing, upload sessions, watch/push listeners or automatic sends. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1 https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.threads https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.labels https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.drafts https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.history/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages.attachments/get https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users/getProfile https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/sending https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/auth/scopes

definitions.name: Trash Gmail Thread (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Trash Gmail Thread: POST /threads/{threadId}/trash. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation THREADS_TRASH. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-host HTTPS request, zero retries, redirect:error, no auto pagination. Optional userId defaults to me. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken selected with config.$connection; named GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret overrides credential token. Token issuance, refresh, OAuth consent, restricted-scope verification and scopes are external prerequisites. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8 JSON; opaque IDs exclude dot/percent/slash before credentials. 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; 100 ms bounded cleanup; 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 256 KiB raw/attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Raw MIME/base64url and threadId are transmitted unchanged; ordered repeated headers are retained. Known resource fields projected; absent remains absent, explicit null rejected where Gmail declares non-null. MIME nesting supports eight child levels and rejects deeper parts. No MIME construction/parsing, upload sessions, watch/push listeners or automatic sends. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1 https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.threads https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.labels https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.drafts https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.history/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages.attachments/get https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users/getProfile https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/sending https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/auth/scopes

definitions.name: Untrash Gmail Thread (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Untrash Gmail Thread: POST /threads/{threadId}/untrash. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation THREADS_UNTRASH. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-host HTTPS request, zero retries, redirect:error, no auto pagination. Optional userId defaults to me. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken selected with config.$connection; named GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret overrides credential token. Token issuance, refresh, OAuth consent, restricted-scope verification and scopes are external prerequisites. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8 JSON; opaque IDs exclude dot/percent/slash before credentials. 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; 100 ms bounded cleanup; 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 256 KiB raw/attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Raw MIME/base64url and threadId are transmitted unchanged; ordered repeated headers are retained. Known resource fields projected; absent remains absent, explicit null rejected where Gmail declares non-null. MIME nesting supports eight child levels and rejects deeper parts. No MIME construction/parsing, upload sessions, watch/push listeners or automatic sends. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1 https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.threads https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.labels https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.drafts https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.history/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages.attachments/get https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users/getProfile https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/sending https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/auth/scopes

definitions.name: Permanently Delete Gmail Thread (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Permanently Delete Gmail Thread: DELETE /threads/{threadId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation THREADS_DELETE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-host HTTPS request, zero retries, redirect:error, no auto pagination. Optional userId defaults to me. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken selected with config.$connection; named GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret overrides credential token. Token issuance, refresh, OAuth consent, restricted-scope verification and scopes are external prerequisites. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8 JSON; opaque IDs exclude dot/percent/slash before credentials. 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; 100 ms bounded cleanup; 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 256 KiB raw/attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Raw MIME/base64url and threadId are transmitted unchanged; ordered repeated headers are retained. Known resource fields projected; absent remains absent, explicit null rejected where Gmail declares non-null. MIME nesting supports eight child levels and rejects deeper parts. No MIME construction/parsing, upload sessions, watch/push listeners or automatic sends. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1 https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.threads https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.labels https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.drafts https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.history/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages.attachments/get https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users/getProfile https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/sending https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/auth/scopes

definitions.name: Batch Modify Gmail Message Labels (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Batch Modify Gmail Message Labels: POST /messages/batchModify. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation MESSAGES_BATCH_MODIFY. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-host HTTPS request, zero retries, redirect:error, no auto pagination. Optional userId defaults to me. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken selected with config.$connection; named GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret overrides credential token. Token issuance, refresh, OAuth consent, restricted-scope verification and scopes are external prerequisites. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8 JSON; opaque IDs exclude dot/percent/slash before credentials. 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; 100 ms bounded cleanup; 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 256 KiB raw/attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Raw MIME/base64url and threadId are transmitted unchanged; ordered repeated headers are retained. Known resource fields projected; absent remains absent, explicit null rejected where Gmail declares non-null. MIME nesting supports eight child levels and rejects deeper parts. No MIME construction/parsing, upload sessions, watch/push listeners or automatic sends. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1 https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.threads https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.labels https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.drafts https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.history/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages.attachments/get https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users/getProfile https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/sending https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/auth/scopes

definitions.name: Batch Permanently Delete Gmail Messages (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Batch Permanently Delete Gmail Messages: POST /messages/batchDelete. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation MESSAGES_BATCH_DELETE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-host HTTPS request, zero retries, redirect:error, no auto pagination. Optional userId defaults to me. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken selected with config.$connection; named GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret overrides credential token. Token issuance, refresh, OAuth consent, restricted-scope verification and scopes are external prerequisites. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8 JSON; opaque IDs exclude dot/percent/slash before credentials. 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; 100 ms bounded cleanup; 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 256 KiB raw/attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Raw MIME/base64url and threadId are transmitted unchanged; ordered repeated headers are retained. Known resource fields projected; absent remains absent, explicit null rejected where Gmail declares non-null. MIME nesting supports eight child levels and rejects deeper parts. No MIME construction/parsing, upload sessions, watch/push listeners or automatic sends. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1 https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.threads https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.labels https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.drafts https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.history/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages.attachments/get https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users/getProfile https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/sending https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/auth/scopes

definitions.name: Send Gmail Message (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Send Gmail Message: POST /messages/send. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation MESSAGES_SEND. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-host HTTPS request, zero retries, redirect:error, no auto pagination. Optional userId defaults to me. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken selected with config.$connection; named GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret overrides credential token. Token issuance, refresh, OAuth consent, restricted-scope verification and scopes are external prerequisites. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8 JSON; opaque IDs exclude dot/percent/slash before credentials. 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; 100 ms bounded cleanup; 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 256 KiB raw/attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Raw MIME/base64url and threadId are transmitted unchanged; ordered repeated headers are retained. Known resource fields projected; absent remains absent, explicit null rejected where Gmail declares non-null. MIME nesting supports eight child levels and rejects deeper parts. No MIME construction/parsing, upload sessions, watch/push listeners or automatic sends. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1 https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.threads https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.labels https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.drafts https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.history/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages.attachments/get https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users/getProfile https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/sending https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/auth/scopes

definitions.name: Insert Gmail Message (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Insert Gmail Message: POST /messages. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation MESSAGES_INSERT. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-host HTTPS request, zero retries, redirect:error, no auto pagination. Optional userId defaults to me. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken selected with config.$connection; named GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret overrides credential token. Token issuance, refresh, OAuth consent, restricted-scope verification and scopes are external prerequisites. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8 JSON; opaque IDs exclude dot/percent/slash before credentials. 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; 100 ms bounded cleanup; 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 256 KiB raw/attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Raw MIME/base64url and threadId are transmitted unchanged; ordered repeated headers are retained. Known resource fields projected; absent remains absent, explicit null rejected where Gmail declares non-null. MIME nesting supports eight child levels and rejects deeper parts. No MIME construction/parsing, upload sessions, watch/push listeners or automatic sends. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1 https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.threads https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.labels https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.drafts https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.history/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages.attachments/get https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users/getProfile https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/sending https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/auth/scopes

definitions.name: Import Gmail Message (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Import Gmail Message: POST /messages/import. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation MESSAGES_IMPORT. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-host HTTPS request, zero retries, redirect:error, no auto pagination. Optional userId defaults to me. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken selected with config.$connection; named GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret overrides credential token. Token issuance, refresh, OAuth consent, restricted-scope verification and scopes are external prerequisites. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8 JSON; opaque IDs exclude dot/percent/slash before credentials. 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; 100 ms bounded cleanup; 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 256 KiB raw/attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Raw MIME/base64url and threadId are transmitted unchanged; ordered repeated headers are retained. Known resource fields projected; absent remains absent, explicit null rejected where Gmail declares non-null. MIME nesting supports eight child levels and rejects deeper parts. No MIME construction/parsing, upload sessions, watch/push listeners or automatic sends. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1 https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.threads https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.labels https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.drafts https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.history/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages.attachments/get https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users/getProfile https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/sending https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/auth/scopes

definitions.name: List Gmail Threads (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
List Gmail Threads: GET /threads. One fixed-host HTTPS request, zero retries, redirect:error, no auto pagination. Optional userId defaults to me. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken selected with config.$connection; named GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret overrides credential token. Token issuance, refresh, OAuth consent, restricted-scope verification and scopes are external prerequisites. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8 JSON; opaque IDs exclude dot/percent/slash before credentials. 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; 100 ms bounded cleanup; 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 256 KiB raw/attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Raw MIME/base64url and threadId are transmitted unchanged; ordered repeated headers are retained. Known resource fields projected; absent remains absent, explicit null rejected where Gmail declares non-null. MIME nesting supports eight child levels and rejects deeper parts. No MIME construction/parsing, upload sessions, watch/push listeners or automatic sends. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1 https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.threads https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.labels https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.drafts https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.history/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages.attachments/get https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users/getProfile https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/sending https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/auth/scopes

definitions.name: Get Gmail Thread (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Get Gmail Thread: GET /threads/{threadId}. One fixed-host HTTPS request, zero retries, redirect:error, no auto pagination. Optional userId defaults to me. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken selected with config.$connection; named GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret overrides credential token. Token issuance, refresh, OAuth consent, restricted-scope verification and scopes are external prerequisites. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8 JSON; opaque IDs exclude dot/percent/slash before credentials. 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; 100 ms bounded cleanup; 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 256 KiB raw/attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Raw MIME/base64url and threadId are transmitted unchanged; ordered repeated headers are retained. Known resource fields projected; absent remains absent, explicit null rejected where Gmail declares non-null. MIME nesting supports eight child levels and rejects deeper parts. No MIME construction/parsing, upload sessions, watch/push listeners or automatic sends. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1 https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.threads https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.labels https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.drafts https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.history/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages.attachments/get https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users/getProfile https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/sending https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/auth/scopes

definitions.name: List Gmail Labels (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
List Gmail Labels: GET /labels. One fixed-host HTTPS request, zero retries, redirect:error, no auto pagination. Optional userId defaults to me. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken selected with config.$connection; named GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret overrides credential token. Token issuance, refresh, OAuth consent, restricted-scope verification and scopes are external prerequisites. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8 JSON; opaque IDs exclude dot/percent/slash before credentials. 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; 100 ms bounded cleanup; 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 256 KiB raw/attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Raw MIME/base64url and threadId are transmitted unchanged; ordered repeated headers are retained. definitions.name: Get Gmail Label (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Get Gmail Label: GET /labels/{labelId}. One fixed-host HTTPS request, zero retries, redirect:error, no auto pagination. Optional userId defaults to me. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken selected with config.$connection; named GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret overrides credential token. Token issuance, refresh, OAuth consent, restricted-scope verification and scopes are external prerequisites. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8 JSON; opaque IDs exclude dot/percent/slash before credentials. 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; 100 ms bounded cleanup; 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 256 KiB raw/attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Raw MIME/base64url and threadId are transmitted unchanged; ordered repeated headers are retained. Known resource fields projected; absent remains absent, explicit null rejected where Gmail declares non-null. MIME nesting supports eight child levels and rejects deeper parts. No MIME construction/parsing, upload sessions, watch/push listeners or automatic sends. definitions.name: Create Gmail Label (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Create Gmail Label: POST /labels. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation LABELS_CREATE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-host HTTPS request, zero retries, redirect:error, no auto pagination. Optional userId defaults to me. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken selected with config.$connection; named GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret overrides credential token. Token issuance, refresh, OAuth consent, restricted-scope verification and scopes are external prerequisites. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8 JSON; opaque IDs exclude dot/percent/slash before credentials. 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; 100 ms bounded cleanup; 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 256 KiB raw/attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Raw MIME/base64url and threadId are transmitted unchanged; ordered repeated headers are retained. Known resource fields projected; absent remains absent, explicit null rejected where Gmail declares non-null. MIME nesting supports eight child levels and rejects deeper parts. No MIME construction/parsing, upload sessions, watch/push listeners or automatic sends. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1 https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.threads https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.labels https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.drafts https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.history/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages.attachments/get https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users/getProfile https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/sending https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/auth/scopes

definitions.name: Patch Gmail Label (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Patch Gmail Label: PATCH /labels/{labelId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation LABELS_PATCH. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-host HTTPS request, zero retries, redirect:error, no auto pagination. Optional userId defaults to me. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken selected with config.$connection; named GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret overrides credential token. Token issuance, refresh, OAuth consent, restricted-scope verification and scopes are external prerequisites. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8 JSON; opaque IDs exclude dot/percent/slash before credentials. 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; 100 ms bounded cleanup; 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 256 KiB raw/attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Raw MIME/base64url and threadId are transmitted unchanged; ordered repeated headers are retained. Known resource fields projected; absent remains absent, explicit null rejected where Gmail declares non-null. MIME nesting supports eight child levels and rejects deeper parts. No MIME construction/parsing, upload sessions, watch/push listeners or automatic sends. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1 https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.threads https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.labels https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.drafts https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.history/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages.attachments/get https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users/getProfile https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/sending https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/auth/scopes

definitions.name: Update Gmail Label (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Update Gmail Label: PUT /labels/{labelId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation LABELS_UPDATE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-host HTTPS request, zero retries, redirect:error, no auto pagination. Optional userId defaults to me. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken selected with config.$connection; named GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret overrides credential token. Token issuance, refresh, OAuth consent, restricted-scope verification and scopes are external prerequisites. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8 JSON; opaque IDs exclude dot/percent/slash before credentials. 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; 100 ms bounded cleanup; 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 256 KiB raw/attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Raw MIME/base64url and threadId are transmitted unchanged; ordered repeated headers are retained. Known resource fields projected; absent remains absent, explicit null rejected where Gmail declares non-null. MIME nesting supports eight child levels and rejects deeper parts. No MIME construction/parsing, upload sessions, watch/push listeners or automatic sends. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1 https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.threads https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.labels https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.drafts https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.history/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages.attachments/get https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users/getProfile https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/sending https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/auth/scopes

definitions.name: Permanently Delete Gmail Label (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Permanently Delete Gmail Label: DELETE /labels/{labelId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation LABELS_DELETE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-host HTTPS request, zero retries, redirect:error, no auto pagination. Optional userId defaults to me. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken selected with config.$connection; named GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret overrides credential token. Token issuance, refresh, OAuth consent, restricted-scope verification and scopes are external prerequisites. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8 JSON; opaque IDs exclude dot/percent/slash before credentials. 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; 100 ms bounded cleanup; 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 256 KiB raw/attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Raw MIME/base64url and threadId are transmitted unchanged; ordered repeated headers are retained. Known resource fields projected; absent remains absent, explicit null rejected where Gmail declares non-null. MIME nesting supports eight child levels and rejects deeper parts. No MIME construction/parsing, upload sessions, watch/push listeners or automatic sends. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1 https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.threads https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.labels https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.drafts https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.history/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages.attachments/get https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users/getProfile https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/sending https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/auth/scopes

definitions.name: List Gmail Drafts (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
List Gmail Drafts: GET /drafts. One fixed-host HTTPS request, zero retries, redirect:error, no auto pagination. Optional userId defaults to me. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken selected with config.$connection; named GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret overrides credential token. Token issuance, refresh, OAuth consent, restricted-scope verification and scopes are external prerequisites. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8 JSON; opaque IDs exclude dot/percent/slash before credentials. 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; 100 ms bounded cleanup; 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 256 KiB raw/attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Raw MIME/base64url and threadId are transmitted unchanged; ordered repeated headers are retained. Known resource fields projected; absent remains absent, explicit null rejected where Gmail declares non-null. MIME nesting supports eight child levels and rejects deeper parts. No MIME construction/parsing, upload sessions, watch/push listeners or automatic sends. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1 https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.threads https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.labels https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.drafts https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.history/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages.attachments/get https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users/getProfile https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/sending https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/auth/scopes

definitions.name: Get Gmail Draft (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Get Gmail Draft: GET /drafts/{draftId}. One fixed-host HTTPS request, zero retries, redirect:error, no auto pagination. Optional userId defaults to me. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken selected with config.$connection; named GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret overrides credential token. Token issuance, refresh, OAuth consent, restricted-scope verification and scopes are external prerequisites. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8 JSON; opaque IDs exclude dot/percent/slash before credentials. 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; 100 ms bounded cleanup; 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 256 KiB raw/attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Raw MIME/base64url and threadId are transmitted unchanged; ordered repeated headers are retained. Known resource fields projected; absent remains absent, explicit null rejected where Gmail declares non-null. MIME nesting supports eight child levels and rejects deeper parts. No MIME construction/parsing, upload sessions, watch/push listeners or automatic sends. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1 https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.threads https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.labels https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.drafts https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.history/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages.attachments/get https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users/getProfile https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/sending https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/auth/scopes

definitions.name: Create Gmail Draft (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Create Gmail Draft: POST /drafts. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation DRAFTS_CREATE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-host HTTPS request, zero retries, redirect:error, no auto pagination. Optional userId defaults to me. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken selected with config.$connection; named GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret overrides credential token. Token issuance, refresh, OAuth consent, restricted-scope verification and scopes are external prerequisites. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8 JSON; opaque IDs exclude dot/percent/slash before credentials. 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; 100 ms bounded cleanup; 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 256 KiB raw/attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Raw MIME/base64url and threadId are transmitted unchanged; ordered repeated headers are retained. Known resource fields projected; absent remains absent, explicit null rejected where Gmail declares non-null. MIME nesting supports eight child levels and rejects deeper parts. No MIME construction/parsing, upload sessions, watch/push listeners or automatic sends. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1 https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.threads https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.labels https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.drafts https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.history/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages.attachments/get https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users/getProfile https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/sending https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/auth/scopes

definitions.name: Replace Gmail Draft (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Replace Gmail Draft: PUT /drafts/{draftId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation DRAFTS_UPDATE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-host HTTPS request, zero retries, redirect:error, no auto pagination. Optional userId defaults to me. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken selected with config.$connection; named GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret overrides credential token. Token issuance, refresh, OAuth consent, restricted-scope verification and scopes are external prerequisites. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8 JSON; opaque IDs exclude dot/percent/slash before credentials. 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; 100 ms bounded cleanup; 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 256 KiB raw/attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Raw MIME/base64url and threadId are transmitted unchanged; ordered repeated headers are retained. Known resource fields projected; absent remains absent, explicit null rejected where Gmail declares non-null. MIME nesting supports eight child levels and rejects deeper parts. No MIME construction/parsing, upload sessions, watch/push listeners or automatic sends. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1 https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.threads https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.labels https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.drafts https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.history/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages.attachments/get https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users/getProfile https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/sending https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/auth/scopes

definitions.name: Permanently Delete Gmail Draft (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Permanently Delete Gmail Draft: DELETE /drafts/{draftId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation DRAFTS_DELETE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-host HTTPS request, zero retries, redirect:error, no auto pagination. Optional userId defaults to me. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken selected with config.$connection; named GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret overrides credential token. Token issuance, refresh, OAuth consent, restricted-scope verification and scopes are external prerequisites. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8 JSON; opaque IDs exclude dot/percent/slash before credentials. 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; 100 ms bounded cleanup; 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 256 KiB raw/attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Raw MIME/base64url and threadId are transmitted unchanged; ordered repeated headers are retained. Known resource fields projected; absent remains absent, explicit null rejected where Gmail declares non-null. MIME nesting supports eight child levels and rejects deeper parts. No MIME construction/parsing, upload sessions, watch/push listeners or automatic sends. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1 https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.threads https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.labels https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.drafts https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.history/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages.attachments/get https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users/getProfile https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/sending https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/auth/scopes

definitions.name: Send Gmail Draft (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Send Gmail Draft: POST /drafts/send. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation DRAFTS_SEND. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-host HTTPS request, zero retries, redirect:error, no auto pagination. Optional userId defaults to me. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken selected with config.$connection; named GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret overrides credential token. Token issuance, refresh, OAuth consent, restricted-scope verification and scopes are external prerequisites. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8 JSON; opaque IDs exclude dot/percent/slash before credentials. 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; 100 ms bounded cleanup; 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 256 KiB raw/attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Raw MIME/base64url and threadId are transmitted unchanged; ordered repeated headers are retained. Known resource fields projected; absent remains absent, explicit null rejected where Gmail declares non-null. MIME nesting supports eight child levels and rejects deeper parts. No MIME construction/parsing, upload sessions, watch/push listeners or automatic sends. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1 https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.threads https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.labels https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.drafts https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.history/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages.attachments/get https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users/getProfile https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/sending https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/auth/scopes

definitions.name: List Gmail History (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
List Gmail History: GET /history. One fixed-host HTTPS request, zero retries, redirect:error, no auto pagination. Optional userId defaults to me. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken selected with config.$connection; named GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret overrides credential token. Token issuance, refresh, OAuth consent, restricted-scope verification and scopes are external prerequisites. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8 JSON; opaque IDs exclude dot/percent/slash before credentials. 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; 100 ms bounded cleanup; 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 256 KiB raw/attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Raw MIME/base64url and threadId are transmitted unchanged; ordered repeated headers are retained. Known resource fields projected; absent remains absent, explicit null rejected where Gmail declares non-null. MIME nesting supports eight child levels and rejects deeper parts. No MIME construction/parsing, upload sessions, watch/push listeners or automatic sends. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1 https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.threads https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.labels https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.drafts https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.history/list https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users.messages.attachments/get https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users/getProfile https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/sending https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/auth/scopes
